The midterms will shape Congress for the last years of his presidency, writes Sarah Smith, but they are also a test of what politics may look like without him.

US & Canada

Seven planes searched after suspected bomb threats across Europe

One flight to Warsaw was diverted, while another in Rome was escorted by a military jet. No explosives have been found.

Jet may have broken apart before Florida crash, officials say, as family named among victims

Adam Robinson, Helen Sharp, and their two children - Emma, four, and Charlie, two - died after the plane nosedived.

Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision

Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel dies aged 30 after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match.
